snippet.title: DOFUS Touch | The ultimate MMORPG on mobile
snippet.description:
Absolutely killer characters, terrifying bosses and friends you can count on – that's what's waiting for you!
SUBSCRIBE TO THE CHANNEL: https://www.youtube.com/user/dofus

Are you wondering why you still haven't played this game even though it regularly pops up in your feed? So are we!

DOFUS Touch is the biggest tactical MMORPG that you can have on your little smartphone. The World of Twelve is so vast, you'll never explore it all.

And who better to explore, conquer dungeons, defeat monsters and earn coveted rewards with than your friends? Maybe… new friends. Who knows? It's possible!

Play a character of your choosing, give them weapons, sets, pets and petsmounts, and turn them into a legend! When you're ready, create a guild with your friends or join a guild. Together, fight epic battles and build lasting memories.

DOWNLOAD DOFUS TOUCH:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ankama.dofustouch
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/dofus-touch/id1041406978

FOLLOW ALL THE LATEST NEWS: https://www.dofus-touch.com/fr
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/DOFUSTouch/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DofusTouch
Talk to other players on the forums:
https://www.dofus-touch.com/fr/forum#ANKAMA

#DOFUSTouch #RPG
